services.eyebrow: 01 — What I can grow for you
services.title: One developer for the whole ecosystem.
services.intro: No hand-offs between a “front-end person” and a “back-end person”. You get one accountable partner who understands how every layer connects.

apps.title: Custom web apps & SaaS
apps.body: Dashboards, client portals and multi-tenant platforms built on Laravel or Symfony with a React / Next.js front end.

apis.title: APIs & integrations
apis.body: Secure REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth and token auth — and the glue that connects your tools to Google, payments and third parties.

websites.title: Websites & WordPress
websites.body: Fast, responsive sites and custom WordPress plugins your team can actually manage after launch.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce & marketplaces
ecommerce.body: Stores and multi-vendor marketplaces with online payments, including PayPal and Morocco’s CMI gateway.

analytics.title: Analytics & automation
analytics.body: GA4 setup and automation, lead tracking and the scripts that take repetitive work off your plate.

care.title: Care & maintenance
care.body: Updates, performance tuning, Docker-based deployments and fixes — so your product stays healthy long after launch.

rivulet.title: Rivulet — a gamified app for tasks, goals and habits
rivulet.body: My own side project, designed and built solo: a free app that turns tasks, goals and habits into visible progress and rewards. Built around a human idea — people aren’t robots — with custom routine exceptions to pause for travel, events or a slower week without losing your streak.

emi.title: Europe Maroc Immobilier — a real estate agency website
emi.body: Website for a Moroccan real estate agency with offices in Casablanca, Marrakech and Oujda: sale and rental listings with search by city and property type, furnished rentals, property management and B2B pages.

myWall.title: My Wall — a marketplace for independent artists
myWall.body: Designed and built an open marketplace where artists upload their work and sell it across wall art, home decor and lifestyle products, with PayPal and CMI payment integration.

add.title: A website builder for car dealerships
add.body: At Auto Dealers Digital I helped build a SaaS website builder on Laravel and WordPress, with event-driven REST endpoints, webhooks and queued jobs for speed.

ga4.title: GA4, managed by code
ga4.body: Automated the creation and management of Google Analytics 4 properties and data with PHP libraries, replacing manual setup.

leadTracking.title: Lead tracking that personalises content
leadTracking.body: Collected and analysed lead-tracking data to tailor what visitors see and lift engagement.

seed.label: 01 · Seed
seed.title: Discovery
seed.body: A free call to understand your goals, users and budget. You get a clear scope and estimate.

root.label: 02 · Root
root.title: Architecture
root.body: Technical design and data model first, so the product has foundations that scale.

grow.label: 03 · Grow
grow.title: Build in sprints
grow.body: Agile iterations with a staging link you can click through every week. No black boxes.

bloom.label: 04 · Bloom
bloom.title: Launch & care
bloom.body: Deployment, documentation and handover — plus ongoing support if you want it.

fixed.title: Fixed-scope project
fixed.body: A website, app or integration with a clear brief, timeline and price agreed up front.

monthly.title: Monthly partnership
monthly.body: A dedicated block of development each month for products that keep evolving.

consulting.title: Consulting & audits
consulting.body: Code reviews, performance checks and technical advice on your existing stack.

hero.title:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer.

Deep roots in the back end, a canopy in React.
hero.intro: 8+ years designing, building and maintaining SaaS platforms, REST APIs, dashboards and e-commerce systems — strong PHP fundamentals (Laravel, Symfony) and a growing focus on API-first architectures with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Docker.

stack.title: A root system, not a buzzword list.
stack.intro: What users see grows from what they don’t. Above the soil line: the interface. Below it: the services, data and infrastructure that keep everything alive.

independent.body: Designing and shipping websites and web applications for clients with React / Next.js, JavaScript / TypeScript and Symfony.

bullets.b1: Contributed to a SaaS website builder built on Laravel and WordPress.
bullets.b2: Built secure, event-driven REST endpoints and webhooks with token auth and asynchronous Laravel queues.
bullets.b3: Automated GA4 property and data management with PHP libraries.
bullets.b4: Collected and analysed lead-tracking data to personalise content (JavaScript, MongoDB, Python / FastAPI).

delit.body: Responsive interfaces with configurable Twig templates; e-commerce work alongside senior engineers on Sylius.

myWall.body: Designed and built an open marketplace for independent artists — wall art, home decor and lifestyle products — on Laravel with PayPal and CMI payments.

irma.body: Requirements analysis and websites for small businesses (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript / jQuery, PHP, WordPress); improved the data-archiving process of an internal PHP application.

solid.title: SOLID & OOP
solid.body: Object-oriented design and patterns that keep large codebases readable.

review.title: Reviews & testing
review.body: Code reviews, Git workflows and tests as part of every change.

performance.title: Performance
performance.body: Async queues, caching with Redis and lean queries for fast, resilient apps.

docs.title: Agile & documented
docs.body: Scrum rituals and technical documentation teammates can build on.
